note: Small Lakeland Provincial Recreation Area campground near Ironwood Lake, south of Lac La Biche, reached by township and range roads: sites in the trees above the lake, with a boat launch, pier and fish-cleaning station. Hand-pump water and free firewood mid-May to mid-September; after the September long weekend services are reduced, and after Thanksgiving there is no snow removal or service. --Claude
